SALAH_WIDGET · OFFLINE ENGINEERING REFERENCE

Real stars. Explicit assumptions.

8,921 authenticated catalogue records, with location-dependent geometry and a linear-light point-source renderer. This is a standalone test viewer, not a screenshot of the integrated prayer widget.

Physical sky and observer

Atmosphere assumptions
Supplied conditions are assumptions, not a forecast. Cloud transmission is direct line-of-sight transparency, not percentage cloud cover.
No remote catalogue calls, location permission, forecast or system-clock dependence. UTC and location now drive physical Sun/Moon illumination. Background, direct stellar transmission and display contrast are separate. Sun/Moon markers are annotations; their material discs belong to the host widget.

HYG 4.0: David Nash / Astronexus · data CC BY-SA 4.0. Patterns: Stellarium Western v0.22.2. Regions: Roman 1987 / Astropy. Brightness is catalogue mean V, not live variable-star photometry. CP5: V-passband anchoring and tabulated CIE response. Vega/Regulus use legacy measured spectrophotometric shapes; matched A0V/B7V sources may use labelled templates. Others use colour-constrained estimates or declared unknowns. Gaussian PSFs approximate optics, not resolved stellar surfaces. CP6: spherical spectral sunlight plus a measured-site twilight residual, empirical lunar sky light and declared natural/cloud inputs. This is not full multiple-scattering radiative transfer or measured local weather. Moon/night colours are neutral proxies. No fictional stars or decorative Milky Way dots are rendered.
